teams.detail: Fell to Miami 6-5 in 10 innings Tuesday on a Jakob Marsee walk-off single, dropping to 47-45 but still atop the AL West. Back in action tonight at Miami, 6:40 PM ET — game had not yet started as of this brief.

Vegas Summer League opens tomorrow (Thu 7/9) vs. the 76ers, 5:30 PM ET at Cox Pavilion (Prime Video). Off the court, restricted free agent center Jalen Duren is exploring a sign-and-trade to Boston after being underwhelmed by Detroit's offer; the Pistons maintain they aren't interested in a sign-and-trade and are still trying to close the gap.

Seattle acquired WR/special-teamer Irvin Charles from the Jets Wednesday for a conditional 2028 seventh-round pick. Training camp opens July 24 in Renton with public practices starting July 25; RB Zach Charbonnet has a late-July ACL checkup and is 'progressing well,' per ESPN's Jeremy Fowler, with a Week 1 return still in play.

UW hosted a packed junior day, headlined by 4-star QB Blake Roskopf (12th-ranked passer nationally). RB Jordan Washington is still targeting a late-July return from his spring injury as Jedd Fisch enters year three at the helm.

F Hannes Steinbach went 14th overall to the Hornets in June, the 4th-highest German draft pick in NBA history. Danny Sprinkle continues rebuilding through the portal after losing Zoom Diallo, restocking around 2026 signee Lattimore Ford.

headlines.headline: Mavericks formally introduce Dusty May as head coach, pairing the national-champion college coach with Masai Ujiri
headlines.detail: Dallas made official its hire of Dusty May, fresh off leading Michigan to a 37-3 record and the 2026 NCAA title, as head coach — his first NBA job — replacing Jason Kidd. May will work alongside new president of basketball operations Masai Ujiri to build the Mavericks around rookie Cooper Flagg.

headlines.headline: Patriots CB Christian Gonzalez contract standoff looms over July 24 camp report date
headlines.detail: New England's 2023 first-round pick Christian Gonzalez, now one of the NFL's top corners, is pushing for a new extension with the Patriots, having skipped voluntary sessions before attending mandatory minicamp. July 24 is the next real checkpoint before a holdout or hold-in becomes live.

headlines.headline: Big 12 Media Days wrap Day Two in Frisco with Utah, Arizona, TCU among schools presenting
headlines.detail: The second day of Monster Energy Big 12 Football Media Days at The Star featured Arizona, Cincinnati, Iowa State, Kansas, Kansas State, TCU, Utah and West Virginia, closing out the conference's two-day kickoff to the 2026 season.

headlines.headline: Kentucky lands top transfer Milan Momcilovic, jumping into the 2026-27 preseason top tier
headlines.detail: Kentucky closed its offseason by landing Milan Momcilovic, the No. 1-ranked player in this spring's transfer portal, who chose Mark Pope's Wildcats over Louisville and Arizona.
